where: Lumenary halls — the Tinderwick Lumenary (Brisa) and the Pearlmoor Lumenary (Reyl), and any later Lampwarden's hall without its own cue
mood: The hush before the duel — a stately processional between lamp-lit pillars, organ and choir in cool stone, walking toward the warden who will test you.
_note: Matches the classic spec: 90 BPM 4/4, D minor with an F major brass-chorale bridge. Motif low (90 BPM grid suits it).
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
D minor turning to F major
soft sampled pipe organ carrying a reverent melody
processional synth bass walking in half notes
quiet timpani rolls leading each phrase
reverent, anticipatory, cool stone hall interior

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {stepping through the great doors: one awed hit of timpani and full organ chord, then the sound settles at once into a hushed choir and the processional bass}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the processional melody on pipe organ in D minor, a slow rising fifth and a stately stepwise answer, over the walking half-note bass and choir}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the processional again, the choir a little fuller, a soft timpani roll leading the phrase, lamp-bells glinting at its end; it cadences home on D}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a warm brass chorale in F major rises over the organ, noble and resolute like the warden waiting at the far end, then turns on A major}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the organ processional returns in D minor, calm and certain, a timpani roll in the last bar leading straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
